content: Customer Krishna Das called agent Suresh Deshmukh to discuss an expired auto policy (AP-001234) and inquire about a higher renewal premium. The agent explained that the increase was due to overall regional claims. To reduce the premium, the customer opted for a 10% no-claim bonus and a higher deductible for an additional 5% discount. The agent successfully updated the policy and it is now active.

action_items: Update policy with higher deductible option
